prompt:
Goal: Create a clean 4-panel comparison image showing the same white wireless earbuds product rendered by four different AI image models, like an e-commerce product-shot benchmark.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 landscape canvas, pure white background, divided into exactly 4 equal quadrants by thin light-gray horizontal and vertical divider lines.

Layout: Use a 2 by 2 grid with one product render centered in each quadrant and a bold black model label centered near the bottom of each quadrant. Keep generous white space and soft studio shadows under each product.

Panels: Include exactly 4 panels:
1. Top-left: an open glossy white rectangular earbuds charging case, slightly angled, with exactly 2 short-stem earbuds seated inside; translucent lid raised; soft reflections and detailed material lighting. Label: gemini-3-pro-image-preview(Nanobanana Pro)
2. Top-right: a rounded oval glossy white charging case, front-facing, lid open, with exactly 2 long-stem earbuds standing inside; subtle green indicator dot on the front of the case. Label: doubao-seedream-5-0-pro
3. Bottom-left: a front-facing glossy white rounded-rectangle charging case with lid open, exactly 2 AirPods-Pro-style earbuds protruding upward with silicone tips and small black acoustic vents; clear product structure, centered and sharp. Label: gpt-image-2
4. Bottom-right: a front-facing glossy white rounded charging case with lid open, exactly 2 rounded earbuds visible like small domes inside, a small white indicator dot on the front, and a tiny black charging port near the bottom edge. Label: gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview (Nanobanana 2)

Visual style: Minimal premium e-commerce product photography, high-key lighting, glossy white plastic, subtle gray reflections, soft shadows, crisp edges, realistic product rendering, clean comparison-board composition.

Text style: Labels are lowercase/technical model names in bold black sans-serif, horizontally centered in each panel, no extra text.

Constraints: Show exactly 4 product shots and exactly 4 labels. Do not add logos, watermarks, people, hands, packaging, decorative props, colored backgrounds, or additional captions.

promptZh:
目标：创建一个简洁的 4 格对比图像，展示由 4 种不同 AI 图像模型渲染的同一款白色无线耳机产品，类似于电商产品拍摄基准测试。

画布：宽屏 16:9 横向画布，纯白色背景，由细浅灰色水平和垂直分割线精确划分为 4 个等大的象限。

布局：使用 2x2 网格，每个象限中心放置一个产品渲染图，并在每个象限底部附近居中放置一个粗体黑色模型标签。保持充足的留白，并在每个产品下方添加柔和的摄影棚阴影。

面板：包含精确的 4 个面板：
1. 左上：一个打开的亮面白色长方形耳机充电盒，略微倾斜，内部放置 2 只短柄耳机；半透明盖子抬起；具有柔和的反射和细腻的材质光影。标签：gemini-3-pro-image-preview(Nanobanana Pro)
2. 右上：一个圆润的椭圆形亮面白色充电盒，正面朝向，盖子打开，内部立着 2 只长柄耳机；盒身正面有一个细微的绿色指示灯点。标签：doubao-seedream-5-0-pro
3. 左下：一个正面朝向的亮面白色圆角长方形充电盒，盖子打开，2 只 AirPods-Pro 风格的耳机向上突出，带有硅胶耳塞和黑色小声学通气孔；产品结构清晰，居中且锐利。标签：gpt-image-2
4. 右下：一个正面朝向的亮面白色圆润充电盒，盖子打开，内部可见 2 只圆润的耳机，形似小圆顶，盒身正面有一个白色小指示灯点，底部边缘附近有一个微小的黑色充电口。标签：gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview (Nanobanana 2)

视觉风格：极简高端电商产品摄影，高调照明，亮面白色塑料，细腻的灰色反射，柔和阴影，边缘清晰，逼真的产品渲染，简洁的对比项目构图。

文字风格：标签为小写/技术模型名称，采用粗体黑色无衬线字体，在每个面板内水平居中，无额外文字。

约束：展示精确的 4 张产品拍摄图和 4 个标签。不要添加徽标、水印、人物、手部、包装、装饰性道具、彩色背景或额外说明。
